title: Public precision-12 maximal-order closure
objective: Close precision degree-12 public maximal-order performance below five seconds with raw stage evidence and fail-closed generic Buchmann-Lenstra integration

handoff.summary: Added a reproducible exact fresh-field precision-degree12 public benchmark, independent frozen-lattice verification, opt-in five-second regression gate, and durable raw stage receipt. The production-equivalent registered BL and field-analysis functions all reported compiled execution. The ordinary public median is 3620.650 ms and the traced generic control is 3331.347 ms; no new public algorithm hook is required.
risks: The durable timing is deliberately bound to clean source commit 88a1bd2e and its source-current native caches, before central integration commit 80b7847a; do not rewrite that historical identity when integrating the receipt.
The hard five-second assertion is opt-in because absolute performance is a reference-host policy rather than a portable correctness threshold.
next_steps: Cherry-pick the non-overlapping receipt and test commits onto current integration and add test/number-field-maximal-order-precision-public.cjs to the centrally owned node test manifest.
Run pnpm build on integration to exercise production registry autoload, then rerun the focused public test with SAGEJS_NF_PRECISION_PUBLIC_ENFORCE_PERFORMANCE=1.
